description: During a significant meeting ahead of the BRICS Summit, Prime Minister Modi gifted President Putin a translated version of the ancient Tamil text, Thirukkural, by Naira Mkrtchyan. Both leaders held bilateral talks on the sidelines of the Brics summit being held in New Delhi.

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin during the summit.  Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian also arrived for discussions with PM Modi.  Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected for bilateral talks and the summit.  The expanded Brics grouping focuses on development and cooperation among emerging economies.  India hosts the summit under its theme of resilience and innovation.
title: Putin invites PM Modi to Russia for 24th annual summit - key points from Brics summit

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: During an informal car ride in Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin rekindled their camaraderie, continuing their tradition of traveling together. This ride marks their fourth time sharing a vehicle, following earlier occasions in Bishkek and Tianjin. Their private talks during the journey underscore the depth of their diplomatic ties and mutual understanding.
title: PM Modi, Putin share car ride again in Delhi, weeks after traveling together in Bishkek

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.
title: Israel released 28 wild donkeys in desert; 44 years later, they created an oasis

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Vermont town opens 1976 time capsule with a joint and birth-control packaging

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: After two decades in legal turmoil, former Indian cricketer Jacob Martin has finally been acquitted of all charges related to a 2004 case of forgery and cheating. The court's ruling highlighted the absence of credible evidence against Martin, allowing him to close this challenging chapter of his life and career. He can now look forward to a brighter future, free from the shadows of this protracted legal battle.
title: 'My name was not even in the FIR': Former India cricketer’s 22-year ordeal

author: DISHANK PUROHIT
description: A man allegedly killed his wife and three daughters in Jaipur's Kardhani area. He reportedly used a stone to strike them on their heads while they slept. The accused then collected milk from a deliveryman before fleeing the scene. Police are searching for the suspect and investigating a possible family dispute. The victims were found at their home in Govind Vatika early Friday morning.
title: 'Smashed heads with stone': Man kills wife, 3 daughters in Jaipur

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Anthropic revealed state actors used AI for weapons development and intelligence.  A China-based actor built electronic warfare software targeting Taiwan's defenses.  Yemen-based actors developed guided rockets and ballistic missiles using AI.  These AI-enabled threats impact regional security and shipping lanes.  Indian planners must consider these evolving state and non-state AI threats.
title: Terror groups, China turn to off-the-shelf AI to make weapons smarter

title: JPC meet on FCRA Bill: Panel to hold first sitting on Sept 18

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: India is set to roll out a barrier-free digital tolling system by early 2027, allowing vehicles to glide past toll booths without stopping. The integration of number-plate recognition with existing FASTag technology promises to streamline the toll collection process even further. Motorists will experience a new level of convenience as the One Tag system is introduced, significantly reducing wait times and enhancing overall travel efficiency.
title: No-stop toll plazas by March 2027? Nitin Gadkari sets deadline for barrier-free system

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: LeBron and Savannah James made a thoughtful decision to shield their daughter Zhuri from the spotlight for several years, aiming to protect her early years from relentless media attention. Her first public appearance was a natural moment during LeBron's championship celebration in 2016, allowing her to cultivate her own passions independent of basketball. The family emphasized the importance of privacy and personal growth for each of their children.
title: How LeBron and Savannah James protected Zhuri’s childhood from spotlight

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: While investigating a creek for frogs, a scientist stumbled upon a remarkable ancient mastodon tooth, estimated to be over ten thousand years old. Paleontologists have confirmed its belonging to a long-extinct species of Pacific mastodon. The fossil will soon be analyzed at Stanford University to determine its precise age, establishing a fascinating connection between today's conservation initiatives and the ancient ecosystems of California.
title: Scientist surveying California creek finds 10,000-year-old mastodon tooth

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Hawaii introduced red mangroves in 1902; 124 years later, they clog waterways

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The US Department of Homeland Security is advocating for the termination of a sixty-day grace period pertaining to visa holders. This modification has significant implications for skilled workers, particularly those on H-1B and other temporary visas, requiring them to leave the United States immediately upon job termination. The department is currently seeking public feedback before implementing this impactful change that will affect many foreign national employees and their employers.
title: US government proposes removal of 60-day grace period for H-1B visa holders

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a strategic move, Houthi forces have seized the port city of Mocha and are pushing further south towards the crucial Bab el-Mandeb Strait. This escalation shifts their tactics toward controlling Yemen's Red Sea coast, a vital route for global maritime trade connecting Asia with Europe. As tensions rise, the humanitarian situation in Yemen worsens, prompting urgent international calls for intervention to address the impending crisis.
title: Houthis take control of island in Bab el-Mandeb Strait; vital trade artery at risk

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: UPI now dominates Indian merchant payments, significantly reducing card usage. Debit cards are primarily used for cash withdrawals, not shopping. Credit cards are specializing in larger purchases and e-commerce transactions. RuPay credit cards can now link directly to UPI apps. The QR code scan is becoming the default checkout method for everyday purchases.
title: UPI now dominates merchant payments: Are cards becoming less useful?

author: TOI Education
description: Arjun Jain’s journey from struggling with JEE to becoming an IIT Bombay professor highlights how setbacks can redirect, rather than define, a career. After declining an IIT-BHU seat in Petrochemical Engineering, Jain completed Computer Science at RV College of Engineering, pursued a PhD in Germany and conducted postdoctoral research at NYU. His work in computer vision and deep learning led to research, entrepreneurship and industry roles before he returned to IIT Bombay as faculty in 2016.
title: He failed JEE, gave up IIT seat; years later, Arjun Jain became IIT Bombay professor

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: A quarter century after 9/11: 25 ways America's darkest day changed the world

title: Cong v Cong over Brics: Tharoor rebuffs Chidambaram, hails 'power' of summit

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: The former Pakistan captain also asked the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) to give the domestic system enough time to produce results instead of making regular changes. Akram also stressed the need to strengthen cricket at the grassroots level. He called for greater focus on club, school and college cricket to ensure a steady supply of talent.
title: 'Embarrassing': Wasim Akram slams Pakistan's shocking mid-tour changes

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Mirzapur The Movie' is edging closer to a major box office milestone as it enters Day 8, with its India net collection standing at Rs. 149.26 crore after crossing Rs. 148 crore by the end of Day 7. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer is now less than a crore away from the Rs. 150 mark, even as Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan's 'Haiwaan' opens in theatres. Worldwide, the film has already surpassed Rs. 212 crore.
title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 8 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film eyes Rs 150 crore

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Brad Pitt openly reflects on his transformative journey away from a conservative religious upbringing. He emphasizes that this shift was an empowering journey of self-discovery rather than a simple abandonment of faith. His experiences resonate deeply with those grappling with their own belief systems, revealing the power of trusting one’s abilities to confront life’s adversities. Pitt's story underscores the value of introspection and personal agency in shaping one’s path.
title: Quote of the day by Brad Pitt on self-discovery; actor reflects on faith and identity

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: Bengal CM eats fish at Kalighat amid Bageshwar Baba row: What sparked the controversy

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A Kerala consumer commission ordered Bank of India to pay compensation for service deficiency. The bank delayed releasing a deceased woman's savings to her elderly husband. The commission found the bank's procedures unnecessarily burdensome and lacking clear communication. The bank failed to prove its defense regarding an unsigned application. The elderly man suffered financial hardship and mental agony due to the bank's actions.
title: Bank delays release of deceased wife's savings to elderly man; ordered to pay Rs 15K

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Caitlin Clark almost opted for Notre Dame in 2019, but her decision to join Iowa turned out to be a pivotal moment in her basketball journey. With a vision to elevate Iowa's program, she not only became the NCAA's all-time leading scorer but also led her team to two championship appearances, making her choice to remain home a defining chapter in her storied college career.
title: Why Caitlin Clark chose Iowa over Notre Dame and changed her career

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Max Thieriot’s roughly 90-acre Sonoma County ranch has evolved since he and his wife Lexi bought it in 2013. The property now includes the nine-acre Bodega Thieriot Pinot noir vineyard, while the rest remains hillside, woodland and pasture. Though the actor’s family now lives in Washington state for most of the year, he continues returning to the ranch during the off-season.
title: Max Thieriot turned 90-acre Sonoma ranch into vineyard, farm and retreat

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers utilized XCT scanning technology to investigate the unique tail of a viper. The imaging uncovered the presence of standard viper vertebrae within the tail's unusual form. This finding underscores the discrepancies that can exist between external appearance and internal skeletal makeup. Fossilized remains alone may not capture the true look of an organism, while museum specimens remain crucial for advancing our understanding through innovative methods.
title: This snake grows a fake spider on its tail to lure birds

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
title: Luxury home in Corsica? Separatists are bombing multimillion-euro properties

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide.  These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology.  Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries.  The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models.  India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.
title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: A 26-year-old man seeking infertility treatment discovered a rare congenital condition.  He had a uterus and fallopian-tube-like structures inside his body.  Doctors also found undescended testes with severe damage and pre-cancerous changes.  Minimally invasive surgery removed these structures and the damaged testes.  The case highlights the importance of investigating unexplained infertility and undescended testes.
title: Delhi man goes for infertility test, finds out he has uterus

author: HADI KHAN
description: Heavy rain lashed parts of Delhi on Friday as a red alert was issued. Moderate to heavy rainfall is forecast for many areas of the city. Light to moderate rain may also occur in the evening hours. Rainfall activity is expected to continue over Delhi for two days. The weather office issued the alert for the next few hours.
title: Red alert in Delhi after heavy rain lashes parts of city

author: KANCHAN YADAV
description: New Delhi hosts the significant BRICS Summit, bringing together powerful global leaders.  The expanded bloc now represents nearly half the world's population.  India prioritizes practical cooperation in areas like food and energy security.  The summit faces challenges from global disruptions and geopolitical rivalries.  Leaders aim to achieve meaningful outcomes and strengthen collective influence.
title: Putin, Xi and a bigger Brics: India takes its vision for the bloc to global stage

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: A Chinese-origin tank exploded during an exercise, killing two soldiers and injuring another.  This incident follows other nations reporting issues with Chinese military equipment.  Several countries have expressed dissatisfaction with Chinese defense system capabilities.  China remains a major global arms supplier despite these persistent quality complaints.  Bangladesh is still considering purchasing Chinese fighter jets despite past equipment problems.
title: Catastrophic failure: Bangladesh tank blast puts Chinese military hardware under spotlight

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: A 21 Air Boeing 767 touched down at Miami International Airport at an alarming speed of nearly 300 kmph. As the crew attempted to execute a go-around following the landing, they had neglected to deploy the speed brakes, leading to automated alerts about the steep descent and proximity to the ground. Investigators are now analyzing the flight data and cockpit voice recordings to uncover further insights regarding this incident.
title: Miami flight overrun: Plane touched down at nearly 300 kmph despite high-speed warning

author: KAPIL DIXIT
description: Villagers held a mobile tower technician captive for two hours in Fatehpur district. They were frustrated with poor mobile connectivity for approximately two years. Police intervened and rescued the technician after being alerted by another villager. An FIR was registered against unknown villagers following the technician's complaint. Investigations are currently underway regarding the unusual incident.
title: Watch: Fed up over poor network, villagers tie technician with mobile tower

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: 5 killed and 40 injured as bus crashes near Alpine village in Switzerland

author: HADI KHAN
description: A US-based Indian couple alleged passport scanning of their young children at Delhi airport. Staff scanned multiple family passports after one purchase, claiming to check for offers. The couple raised concerns about data collection and potential misuse of personal information. Airport authorities have acknowledged the allegation and promised a thorough investigation. Exemplary action will be taken if the allegations are found to be true.
title: US-based couple flags ‘scam’ at Delhi airport, authorities respond

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 1973, a Kansas student misplaced his class ring during an epic snowball fight. Fast forward fifty-three years later, campus workers discovered the ring while tending to the grounds. Interestingly, the owner and his wife were driving through the city that same day, having just discussed the ring a week earlier. Now, the couple will restore and treasure the sentimental piece.
title: Kansas student lost class ring in snowball fight; 53 years later, it was found

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Steven Spielberg and his wife are selling their stunning Los Angeles ranch for $29.9 million, a significant increase from the $5.75 million they invested in 1999. This gorgeous property features premium equestrian facilities and lavish living quarters. Earlier dreams of a five-story riding stable were scrapped, but the ranch has been a vital component of their real estate holdings for almost three decades.
title: Spielberg’s $5.75m LA horse ranch is now seeking $29.9 million

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A South China Sea drilling incident caused a significant methane leak in 2018.  Ocean scientists observed an ecosystem rapidly responding to the underwater gas release.  Bacteria and worms quickly formed a methane-munching 'worm bed' within two years.  This new biofilter degraded methane effectively, reducing plume height significantly.  However, this rapid ecosystem development caused a notable decrease in original microbial diversity.
title: Methane leak formed 1km plume; bacteria and worms built a bed within 2 years

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
title: DILRMP 3.0 launched: India's land records go digital — what changes

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: OpenAI has pulled its backing for a mathematics event at Caltech after facing backlash from mathematicians. They voiced worries about AI's impact on research integrity and the tendency of AI firms to announce discoveries without validation. Concerns were raised about the unpaid work required to verify results produced by AI systems. OpenAI recognized the transformative, yet disruptive, influence AI has on the mathematical landscape.
title: Mathematicians around the world are very angry with Sam Altman's OpenAI

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Elon Musk believes chess will eventually be fully solved by AI, drawing comparisons with checkers. Magnus Carlsen was less certain, saying he isn't a computer expert but noting chess is already “semi-solved” as a likely draw. Carlsen also praised AI for making chess more accessible, while backing the Global Chess League’s exciting team format and enjoying his visits to India.
title: Elon Musk feels 'chess will be fully solved one day'; what does Carlsen think?

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Before 9/11, US knew Bin Laden was a threat. India-Pakistan tensions were the bigger worry

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At just four years old, Elena Mishra from Odisha has made headlines as the youngest female chess player officially rated by FIDE. Achieving this milestone in the exciting blitz format, her journey began with her parents using a chessboard as a playful toy. Driven by her passion, Elena dreams of becoming a Grandmaster while delighting in the game.
title: At 4, Elena Mishra becomes youngest female FIDE-rated chess player

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple's iPhone Duo and Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 now compete in the foldable phone market.  Apple utilizes a nano-texture finish to reduce glare and minimize crease visibility. Samsung incorporates a titanium layer and strengthened shock-absorbing materials for enhanced durability. Both companies aim to improve screen resilience and reduce reflections effectively. Their contrasting approaches highlight different engineering philosophies in foldable display development.
title: How display of iPhone Duo is different from that of Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Once believed to be extinct, the black-footed ferret is making a stunning comeback across the American plains. In 1986, only eighteen of these animals survived, a dire moment in their history. Through dedicated captive breeding and reintroduction efforts, their population has increased to around four hundred in the wild. This remarkable recovery underscores the critical importance of conservation efforts in protecting endangered species.
title: Just 18 black-footed ferrets survived in 1986; about 400 are now back in wild

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.
title: Pennsylvania Republican wants Lake Erie renamed ‘Lake Pennsylvania’

author: etimes.in
description: The Pataudi Palace, an ancestral estate of Saif Ali Khan, spans ten acres in Gurugram. This imposing structure, built in the 1930s, showcases royal heritage and unique architecture. Ibrahim Kothi, once home to Tiger Pataudi, features a dome inspired by the Sanchi Stupa. Saif Ali Khan repurchased the leased estate in 2014, returning it to family ownership. The palace remains a significant symbol of the Pataudi family's rich history.
title: Saif Ali Khan's Pataudi Palace: Inside 'Haiwaan' actor's ancestral home

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The absence of an original ITR became a key issue. Although the department had information about the substantial sums held in his Indian accounts, there was no tax return on record explaining their nature and source.
title: Indian in Kuwait sent Rs 1.09cr, no ITR; ITAT deletes Rs 5.52L, checks Rs 2.5cr

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Saim Ayub’s return to the Pakistan Test team ended in a nightmare as he was dismissed for a duck in both innings of the third Test against England at Edgbaston. The young opener faced only 11 balls across the two innings, with England pacer Ollie Robinson dismissing him on both occasions.
title: 'He shouldn't be here': Nasser Hussain bashes Pakistan with Sehwag example

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: Saudi crown prince allegedly asked Trump to hit Houthis; US president declined: Report

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: The annual Team 62 fundraiser, founded by Jason and Kylie Kelce, has evolved into a powerful gathering that links Eagles fans with the autism community. In 2026, this inspiring event raised more than $1.26 million in just one night, contributing to an impressive total of $3.69 million since 2021 for the Eagles Autism Foundation.
title: Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce’s $3.69M legacy: How did Team 62 help autism?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Samantha Ruth Prabhu opened up about her life after being diagnosed with myositis, a condition that deeply affected her self-esteem and personal identity. She discovered strength, hope, and faith while navigating through the struggles of her illness. Additionally, she shared the joyful news of her pregnancy during the shooting of a music video, eagerly looking forward to the arrival of her first child.
title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu recalls myositis battle: 'I had no control'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Texas Czech festival marks 50 years as couples return with children, grandchildren

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: After more than a century, the Buckhorn Creek dam has been dismantled, reviving its original flow for the first time in 125 years. A modern ninety-foot bridge now crosses the creek, enhancing access for trail enthusiasts. This ecological restoration significantly improves aquatic habitats, particularly supporting brook trout populations. Additionally, volunteers will introduce native plants along the banks to help stabilize the soil.
title: Michigan creek flows freely again after century-old railroad dam is removed

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Sourav Ganguly stated Mohammed Shami is not overlooked by selectors and remains a champion. Shami's domestic cricket performances are encouraging, and he has achieved much. Ganguly believes it is too early to predict Shami's 2027 World Cup inclusion. He also praised Ishan Kishan's Duleep Trophy efforts for a potential Test return. Ganguly stressed the importance of Test cricket for young players like Kishan.
title: ‘He is not being neglected’: Sourav Ganguly’s blunt verdict on Mohammed Shami

author: TNN
description: A 22-year-old man died after being stabbed seventeen times in east Delhi's Mandawali area.  The fatal altercation occurred near a school on Thursday evening following a dispute.  Police rushed the injured Vansh Dedha to a hospital where doctors pronounced him dead.  One accused, Keshav Kumar, was arrested while his associate is being sought.  Authorities are reviewing CCTV footage and technical surveillance for further investigation.
title: Delhi man, 22, stabbed 17 times near school over suspected affair

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: JD Vance defends Usha's heritage, hits out at Michigan Senate candidate El-Syed

author: SOURAV MODAK
description: East Zone’s Duleep Trophy triumph on Thursday, their first since 2012, offered perhaps the clearest indication yet of the strength of Jharkhand’s emerging batting core. Captain Ishan Kishan led from the front, aggregating 350 runs in the final, while Shikhar Mohan, Kumar Kushagra, Md Kounain Quraishi and Anukul Roy were among the Jharkhand players who made significant contributions during the campaign.
title: How MS Dhoni is quietly shaping Jharkhand's next generation

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are priced from Rs 1,64,900 and Rs 1,79,900 in India. The new Pro models bring a variable aperture main camera, Pro controls, Apple Reference Image, the 2nm A20 Pro chip, a bigger vapour chamber and up to 43 hours of video playback. Pre-orders start September 12, with sales from September 18. Here are the nine features that you should know of before ordering one.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max go on pre-order tomorrow: 9 biggest features to know

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Chattogram district deputy commissioner Mohammad Zahidul Islam Mia ordered his release after Das’s family submitted an application. His mother, 70-year-old Sandhya Rani Dhar, died early on Thursday while undergoing treatment at a hospital in Hathazari. Das was previously associated with Iskcon and serves as a spokesman for Hindu Sammilito Sanatan Jagaran Jote.
title: Hindu monk, in Bangladesh jail, gets 5-hour parole to attend mother's funeral

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Houthis using AI for missiles? Anthropic says Yemen weapons cell using Claude

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023 but later saw its asking price fall to $6.7 million. The 23-acre property has a seven-bedroom mansion, indoor pool, gym, cinema, tennis and padel courts. Ronaldo moved there after returning to Manchester United but later relocated before leaving England for Al-Nassr.
title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s $6.7M estate: Why did his Cheshire mansion lose value?

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Patrick Mahomes is growing frustrated with repeated questions about his knee injury as he prepares for the Kansas City Chiefs’ Week 1 opener against the Denver Broncos. After suffering ACL and LCL tears last December, Mahomes has worked toward a nine-month recovery. He made his desire to move past the injury discussion clear, while head coach Andy Reid offered encouraging news by saying Mahomes is most likely to start.
title: Patrick Mahomes injury: Why is the Chiefs star frustrated by knee doubts?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Dispute within CINTAA escalates with allegations of documents being removed from the office.  Kunickaa Sadanand expressed deep disappointment over the current state of the association.  Police could not prevent document removal without a Charity Commissioner's order.  FWICE members intervened and stopped the vehicle carrying the documents.  Fresh elections are required after a significant number of committee members resigned.
title: Kunickaa Sadanand: Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure took papers from CINTAA office

author: HADI KHAN
description: The Daman administration organized a road safety event for SUV owners. Mahindra Thar and Toyota Fortuner owners participated in a pledge. This initiative aims to promote responsible driving and road safety awareness. The event featured a rally and a road safety pledge administered by the district collector. It addresses ongoing online discussions regarding the image of these popular vehicles.
title: Collector makes Thar, Fortuner owners take road safety pledge, video goes viral

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission dismissed a complaint against Shoppers Stop regarding a paper bag charge. The commission found the case frivolous and imposed exemplary costs on the complainant.  The complainant had previously filed a similar case against the retailer for a carry bag fee.  The commission noted the complainant's history of filing multiple consumer complaints.  This ruling highlights the misuse of consumer protection laws for personal gain.
title: Customer complaint over Shoppers Stop carry bag charges rejected; fined Rs 10K

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At just fourteen, Welsh football freestyler James Taylor has made headlines by winning a bronze medal at the World Championship. In addition to this remarkable achievement, he holds five Guinness World Records, showcasing his dedication and hard work. Learning through online tutorials and daily practice, James has inspired his younger brother, who also boasts three world records, bringing their family total to an impressive eight.
title: Welsh teen taught himself football freestyle on YouTube; now holds 5 world records

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Discarded mine pipes become shelters for threatened northern quolls in Australia

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Magnus Carlsen’s transition into fatherhood has reshaped how he approaches chess, work and time. Despite unprecedented success, he still sees himself as a provider, balancing the joy of raising his son with the demands of a global career. Fatherhood helped cement his decision to abandon the classical World Championship, revealing a man reallocating ambition around family, responsibility and purpose.
title: Spider-Man, Batman all had to pay rent: Magnus Carlsen, now a father, is no exception

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Sunil Gavaskar highlights the need to reassess India's congested cricket calendar, warning that relentless competition and travel may lead to player fatigue. He underscores the importance of nurturing domestic cricket as the foundation for the national team, advocating for improvements in this area to ensure sustained success in the future. This commentary aligns with the ICC's forthcoming discussions on scheduling.
title: ‘India national team is not Indian cricket’: Gavaskar’s message to BCCI and ICC

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: The Enforcement Directorate searched nine locations across three states in an alleged bank fraud case.  Ramnandi Hotels and Resorts Ltd is accused of diverting Rs 58 crore from bank loans.  The company allegedly used fake reports and personal guarantees to secure these funds.  Five pledged properties were reportedly sold at undervalued prices recently.  The agency suspects these actions aimed to prevent asset attachment and recover crime proceeds.
title: ED raids Ramnandi Hotels across 9 locations in alleged Rs 132-crore bank fraud case

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: LeBron James became a father at 19, just as his NBA career was taking off. Reflecting on his own childhood without his biological father, he told the Akron Beacon Journal in October 2004, “That’s my main goal, to try and be a better father than the one I had.” Over the years, James has emphasized family, presence and guiding his children while allowing them to create their own paths.
title: LeBron James’ pain became a promise: His inspiring journey as a Father

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Tanya Chaudhary has etched her name in history by setting a new national hammer throw record, achieving an impressive distance of 68.35m. This surpasses the former best of 67.02m set by Anushka Yadav during the Indian Athletics Series Final. Despite facing injuries and a tough qualification journey, she is now gearing up for the Asian Games in Japan, with an eye on hitting the coveted 70m mark in future events.
title: Tanya sets National Record: Breaks 68.35m mark; now eyes 70m at Asian Games

author: HADI KHAN
description: Police are investigating Subrat Manocha's knowledge of his father's murder plot. His wife, Shalu Manocha, allegedly planned the killing with two contract killers. Investigators are examining digital communication between Shalu and one of the alleged contract killers. Shalu's family has rejected the allegations against her, stating she was close to the victim. The investigation continues to establish Subrat's potential involvement in the crime.
title: ‘Looked after his food, medicine’: Family of 'killer bahu' denies charges

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: India's economy showcased remarkable resilience by achieving a robust 7.8 percent GDP growth for the April-June quarter, surpassing forecasts. The strength of the services and export sectors contributed significantly to this success. The International Monetary Fund lauded India's economic achievements and its pivotal role as a global growth driver, also acknowledging improvements in macroeconomic statistics and data quality. This comes amid ongoing evaluations of India's latest GDP figures.
title: ‘Key growth engine’: IMF hails India’s 7.8% growth, backs GDP estimate changes

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Parul Gulati advocates for a dynamic posting schedule on Instagram, featuring three posts daily for optimal business outreach. Morning content focuses on direct sales opportunities, catering to early risers. Afternoon visuals are crafted to captivate users as they browse. Finally, evening posts aim to activate laughter and relaxation, helping followers to decompress after a busy day, thereby improving overall engagement through deliberate content timing.
title: Parul Gulati shares 3-post strategy: 'People want different things'

author: ARGHANSHU BOSE
description: The newest iPhone 18 Pro introduces an innovative variable aperture system, empowering photographers with improved control over light. This significant enhancement allows users to manually adjust depth of field and motion capture, providing unprecedented creative opportunities. With its main camera offering four distinct aperture settings, users can enjoy enhanced low-light performance and exquisite detail, seamlessly blending optical prowess with powerful computational capabilities.
title: iPhone 18 Pro series get Variable Aperture as 'most important' camera feature

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: $5,000 DBT scheme in US: Trump says Congress' approval not needed for payout

author: YUDHVIR RANA
description: Pakistani authorities stopped Sikh pilgrims from flying to India for their pilgrimage.  Devotees were stranded at Faisalabad International Airport after being asked for an NOC.  Pilgrims missed their scheduled flights to Delhi due to the unexpected requirement.  They had already spent significant money on travel arrangements for the journey.  The group now awaits government permission to travel via the Attari-Wagah land border.
title: Pakistan stops Sikh pilgrims bound for Hemkund Sahib at Faisalabad airport

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: NIA chargesheet details terror module progression from fertilizer explosives to IEDs. Doctors allegedly tested explosive mixtures and firearms in isolated locations. Weapons were procured using funds routed through a university doctor. Rented premises stored chemicals, equipment, and explosives away from public view. A major cache of ammonium nitrate was seized before the Red Fort blast.
title: Al-Falah docs 1st tested bombs inside university, then in Aravalis: NIA

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: Brics summit: What’s on agenda as world leaders gather in Delhi amid global tensions

author: RAJIV KALKOD
description: A father allegedly strangled his two young daughters at a hotel last month. He confessed to investigators, citing love and worries about their future. The man was overcome by fears following his marriage breakdown and separation. Police recovered a suicide note detailing marital discord and alleged infidelity. He is currently in judicial custody after recovering from a suicide attempt.
title: ‘Found wife’s chats with colleague’: B’luru man breaks down during murder probe

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Hong Kong once had a strong civil society, regular mass protests and a relatively open press. Since the 2019 protest movement, however, the authorities have restricted political participation and prosecuted prominent activists and media figures. Several civil society groups have shut down, including the alliance behind the Tiananmen gatherings. In February, former pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai was sentenced to 20 years in prison under the security law.
title: China-controlled Hong Kong to punish 3 who organised vigils for Tiananmen massacre

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: The assistance is being provided as the Houthis expand their operations along Yemen’s Red Sea coast. Military sources said the group seized the port city of Mocha on Thursday and moved towards strategic islands, including Hanish. Yemeni government military sources said the advances had given the Houthis greater leverage over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the southern entrance to the Red Sea and one of the world’s busiest shipping routes.
title: US sends up to 200 troops to help Saudi Arabia fight Iran-backed Houthis: Report

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Anuradha and Vikas Sinha have contributed a remarkable twenty million dollars to the University of North Texas. This generous donation will facilitate the establishment of the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence, dedicated to advancing education in artificial intelligence and analytics. Their commitment not only funds student scholarships but also enhances faculty professorships, fostering the next generation of researchers in the field of technology.
title: Indian-origin couple donates $20M to build AI college in US

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: This week, oil prices surged past a hundred dollars per barrel amidst growing worries over supply disruptions caused by attacks on shipping routes in the Middle East. US fuel prices reflect this trend as supply chains experience strain. The trajectory of future oil prices will heavily depend on China's import choices, with OPEC adjusting its global oil demand growth forecast for 2026.
title: Oil touches $107 per barrel as Hormuz remains choked for over six months

author: V NARAYAN
description: Six individuals, including three women, were arrested by Andheri police for a fake raid.  The accused posed as Income Tax and crime branch officials during the incident.  They allegedly abducted a businessman and his wife from their office premises.  The group demanded a sum of Rs 1 crore to settle the fabricated case.  Police are examining seized phones to uncover the full conspiracy and identify associates.
title: ‘Special 26’: Sacked employee teams up with I-T officials to target ex-boss in 'raid'

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: ‘Shared aspiration for global well-being': PM Modi's message ahead of Brics summit

author: ARANI BASU
description: After months of rehab at the Centre of Excellence (CoE), Jasprit Bumrah and Nitish Kumar Reddy were declared fit to join the team which will fly to Japan for the Asian Games two days after the series. Also on Thursday morning, the Indian cricket board (BCCI) announced that Harshit Rana had suffered another injury during his match simulation test at the CoE on Tuesday. Pacer Yash Thakur was named as his replacement.
title: Bumrah fit, Harshit Rana out: BCCI fires physio ahead of Afghanistan T20Is

title: How Iranian arms helped Houthis seize key Red Sea port in 'lightning' blitz

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon has resigned and warned that AI could “kill us all by the end of the decade” as companies race toward self-improving superintelligence. Coxon says current AI models pose limited extinction risk, but rapid advances could soon enable recursive self-improvement, raising urgent concerns over AI safety, regulation and global coordination.
title: Ex-Anthropic researcher warns AI could 'kill us all by end of decade'

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Princess Diana’s iconic “revenge dress,” designed by Christina Stambolian, is heading to auction for an estimated $150,000 to $300,000. Diana famously wore the black silk gown in 1994, the night King Charles admitted his affair. The dress was last sold in June 1997, just two months before Diana died in Paris.
title: Diana's iconic 'revenge dress' up for auction at $300,000

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Magnus Carlsen says Gukesh should not view his upcoming World Championship match against Javokhir Sindarov as a title defence, but as an opportunity to gain. Carlsen believes Gukesh’s peak level matches or exceeds Sindarov’s, though early momentum will be crucial. He also highlights chess’s psychological nature, suggesting confidence and pressure could significantly influence the short match
title: 'Gukesh not in a position to defend': Carlsen on Championship clash vs Sindarov

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: 'They blew the hell out of Bahrain': US official admits Iran damaged US base

author: TNN
description: Karnataka's Congress government has ordered singing only two stanzas of Vande Mataram. This directive applies to state government programmes and functions held across Karnataka. The decision follows a Union home ministry guideline for singing all six stanzas. The state government aims for uniformity and appropriate protocol during national song renditions. This move occurs amidst a political controversy surrounding the national song's singing.
title: Karnataka govt limits Vande Mataram to 2 stanzas, barring VVIP functions

author: TNN
description: Pandey Reiterates There Is No Going Back On CAS System
title: May tweak F&O settlement price mechanism: Sebi chief

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is nearing a domestic box-office record.  The film is just ten million dollars away from Star Wars: The Force Awakens.  It has already earned over nine hundred twenty-three million dollars domestically.  Worldwide, the movie has crossed two point four billion dollars.  This performance positions it as a major box-office success.
title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' to become first $1bn US box office film

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash's film 'Toxic' continues its theatrical run, earning Rs 39 lakhs on its sixteenth day. The movie's India net collection has now reached Rs 248.24 crore after its recent performance. Its worldwide gross collection has impressively climbed to Rs 339.79 crore. The Kannada version contributed more earnings than the Hindi version on day sixteen. This fairy tale for grown-ups is performing well at the box office.
title: 'Toxic' day 16: Yash film earns Rs 39 lakh, sees 35% drop

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Veteran fast bowler Mohammed Shami recently emphasised the importance of nurturing young Indian cricketers. He highlighted how the pressures of high-stakes tournaments have accelerated their development. Shami is dedicated to offering strategic insights during tough matches. He also reflected on his own drive to stay motivated, even while away from the national team and celebrated his career milestone by capturing the Duleep Trophy during his 100th first-class match.
title: ‘Literally as old as my career’: Why Shami is impressed by Vaibhav Sooryavanshi

author: MEENAKSHI SINHA
description: Densely packed multi-storey paying guest accommodations have been built illegally in Noida villages. These structures often lack essential fire safety and emergency exits, posing significant risks. Many buildings violate building codes, with thin columns and narrow lanes hindering access for emergency services. Demand for affordable housing from students and IT professionals drives this rampant, unsafe construction. Tenants prioritize affordability over documented safety measures in their accommodation choices.
title: In Noida’s PG belt, buildings rise nine floors where two are allowed
